modules.title: Introduction to Word Processing
modules.html:
Creating, formatting and editing documents, tables and mail merge. This section covers introduction to word processing.

Key points

  • MS Word is for: — Word Processing.
  • In Microsoft Word, the feature that automatically moves text to the next line when it reaches the right margin is... — Word Wrap.
  • The outcome of data processing is: — Information.
  • Word Processor: — MS Word.
  • MS Word is used for: — Word Processing.

Worked examples

Q: MS Word is for:
A: Word Processing — Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Word Processing.

Q: In Microsoft Word, the feature that automatically moves text to the next line when it reaches the right margin is...
A: Word Wrap — Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Word Wrap.

quiz.q: In a database, a row is also referred to as a _____.
quiz.solution: A record (or row) contains a complete set of data for a single entity in a database table.

quiz.q: Which of the following is a cloud storage service?
quiz.solution: Google Drive is a file storage and synchronization service developed by Google.

quiz.q: What is the function of the 'Undo' command?
quiz.solution: Undo (Ctrl+Z) allows a user to cancel the most recent command or action performed.

quiz.q: The symbols used in a Flowchart to represent a 'Decision' is a _____.
quiz.solution: In flowcharting, a diamond shape represents a conditional operation or decision (Yes/No).
